layers.name: Issue API Routes
layers.description: Implements server endpoints for creating, listing, inspecting, updating, commenting on, closing, deleting, and summarizing issues.

layers.name: Application Interface
layers.description: Provides the Vue components, controls, dialogs, and visual elements that compose the application's user interface.

layers.name: UI Utilities
layers.description: Provides shared utility functions used to compose classes and support interface behavior.

layers.name: Project Foundation
layers.description: Defines the application's Nuxt and Tauri foundations alongside package metadata, configuration, documentation, and development tooling.

layers.name: Issue Data Types
layers.description: Defines the TypeScript types that represent issues and their associated data.

layers.name: Automation and Health Reports
layers.description: Defines continuous integration and release workflows alongside generated repository health and dead-code analysis data.

layers.name: Shared Application Utilities
layers.description: Provides reusable server and client helpers for command execution, data transformation, API access, attachments, compatibility, favorites, hashing, issues, and Markdown.

layers.name: Documentation and Diagnostics
layers.description: Contains project documentation, repository-analysis guidance, and client-side console logging diagnostics.

layers.name: Utilities and Composables Tests
layers.description: Verifies shared utilities and Vue composables covering CLI behavior, keyboard navigation, attachments, statistics, favorites, hashing, and issue handling.
